Steadfast Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Visa Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $293.08B market cap company. (NYSE:V) has risen 38.13% since June 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.56% the S&P500.
